scope: Outer Banks charter boats from two live marina booking rosters, plus one inland guide business. Statewide for-hire and guide-license denominators are unknown. Individual candidate rows are omitted from this public index.

sources.scope: Public requirements and fees for the Blanket For-Hire Captain's CRFL, the Blanket For-Hire Vessel CRFL, and the Non-Blanket For-Hire Vessel License. No holder or hull roster.
sources.credential_holder: Captain's blanket CRFL: the individual. Both vessel licenses: the vessel. Coast Guard operator credentials are a separate personal credential.
sources.access: Public HTML page. Application packets are issued on request. No search or download of current holders.
sources.rights_basis: nc.gov terms grant copying of non-image files for non-commercial use, unaltered, with citation. They do not grant commercial directory reuse.
sources.attribution: Cite the Division page and the access date for any non-commercial copy.
sources.bulk: No bulk roster. Aggregate sales tables were not used as a vessel denominator.
sources.request_process: Public records: https://www.deq.nc.gov/accessdeq/requesting-public-records. Release of a holder file is unresolved under G.S. 113-170.3.

sources.scope: G.S. 113-174.3: who each of the three licenses authorizes, resident and nonresident fees, passenger coverage, and the Commercial Fishing Vessel Registration consequence.
sources.credential_holder: Person for the captain's blanket CRFL. Vessel for both vessel licenses.
sources.access: Public statute HTML.
sources.rights_basis: Public statute. Website copying terms remain non-commercial. Citing the statute is not a grant to republish a customer list.

sources.role: Confidentiality rule for marine fisheries licensee records
sources.scope: Licensee-kept records and Department compilations of business operations, vessel number and capacity, gear, catch, and fishing location are not Chapter 132 public records. Aggregates that do not identify a licensee are public.
sources.access: Public statute HTML.
sources.rights_basis: The statute withholds identified operational compilations. It publishes no roster and no commercial-reuse grant.
sources.bulk: Identified bulk compilations of licensee operations are confidential.
sources.request_process: Disclosure of the confidential class is limited to a court order, aside from the Department's own aggregate releases.

sources.scope: Blank instructions revised 2025-12 for both vessel licenses. Fields include license choice, passenger tier, applicant identity, and a vessel survey. Survey categories are charter boat, head boat, and guide boat. Not a database of issued licenses.
sources.credential_holder: Vessel. Operator, owner, or business agent may apply.
sources.access: Public application document.
sources.rights_basis: State website content under the non-commercial copying terms. The form is not a roster.
sources.attribution: Cite the DMF vessel application and revision date 2025-12.
sources.request_process: Completed applications are filed with DMF. That filing does not authorize a third party to list the applicant.

sources.scope: Online public-records request form. Confidential information is redacted. For-hire holder files are not among the databases listed as already online.
sources.access: Public request form. No for-hire roster was retrieved.
sources.rights_basis: The page is the published request process. A request was not filed. A release would still be subject to G.S. 113-170.3 and would not by itself authorize a commercial directory.
sources.bulk: Unknown until a specific request is answered.
sources.request_process: Use the online form and describe the license type, year, and fields requested.

sources.role: Website terms covering DEQ and Wildlife Resources Commission pages
sources.scope: Copying and distribution of non-image files is granted for non-commercial use if unaltered and cited. Use of photos and other images is prohibited.
sources.access: Public terms page, linked from the DEQ for-hire page and the Wildlife Resources Commission footer.
sources.rights_basis: Non-commercial copying only. No commercial directory grant and no commercial-permission workflow.
sources.attribution: Citation to the source is a condition of the non-commercial grant.
sources.bulk: The grant covers non-image files already published. It is not a data-product license.

sources.role: Federal website copyright and reuse terms
sources.scope: U.S. government information on NOAA Fisheries websites is not subject to copyright in the United States. The page encourages non-commercial, scientific, and educational use and requests acknowledgement. Third-party materials stay under their own copyright.
sources.access: Public policy page.
sources.rights_basis: Absence of copyright is not a grant to claim a listing or to republish personal contact fields. The page does not expressly authorize a commercial directory.
sources.attribution: Courtesy: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
sources.bulk: Depends on the dataset. This page is not a vessel file.
sources.request_process: Copyrighted third-party material requires the copyright holder's written permission.

sources.publisher: NOAA Fisheries Greater Atlantic Regional Fisheries Office
sources.role: Public commercial vessel-permit file for the Greater Atlantic
sources.scope: 2026 Greater Atlantic commercial vessel-permit summary at https://apps-garfo.fisheries.noaa.gov/permits/data/permits_2026.csv. 3,926 data rows. 106 list a North Carolina home port. This is not a South Atlantic or North Carolina for-hire roster. Exact-name checks of the six coastal sample boats produced zero same-hull matches.
sources.credential_holder: Vessel, with an owner name in the file. These rows are commercial permit holders.
sources.access: Public CSV download. Personal telephone numbers and street addresses were not copied.
sources.rights_basis: The permit page describes the display as a public summary, not a guarantee of renewal. NOAA website policy removes U.S. copyright and does not grant a commercial directory.
sources.attribution: Courtesy: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, Greater Atlantic vessel permit file, 2026, accessed 2026-11-25.
sources.bulk: The CSV is a bulk download of the commercial permit summary. The 106 North Carolina home-port rows are not a for-hire fleet count.
sources.request_process: No additional permission workflow is stated for the published summary. It does not authorize claiming a charter listing.

sources.role: Pointer to Southeast permit FOIA releases

sources.access: Public index. The linked holder file was not retrieved.
sources.rights_basis: The holder file was not retrieved, so its reuse terms were not read.
sources.request_process: The published path is the Southeast FOIA frequent-request portal. A fresh request was not filed.

sources.attribution: Courtesy: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
sources.request_process: Applications go to the Southeast Permits Office. That is an applicant process, not third-party listing permission.

sources.access: Public permit description.
sources.rights_basis: Government permit description. No commercial directory grant.
sources.attribution: Courtesy: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.

sources.scope: Live booking dropdown on 2026-11-25: 47 unique names. Overlapping category counts are offshore 30, nearshore 9, inshore 8, headboat 1, dolphin tour 1, oyster tour 1, and ashes-at-sea 1. WordPress boat slugs are a different set. Defined sample: 3 of 47, with 2 supported and 1 held.
sources.access: Public website. The roster is rendered by an embedded booking widget. Next-year reservations are preliminary until the marina finalizes the fleet.
sources.rights_basis: Terms cover cancellation, deposits, and the rule that next year's fleet and prices are not final until announced. Footer copyright 2022. No clause grants commercial directory reuse or authority to claim a listing.
sources.bulk: The dropdown is a complete current booking list of 47 names. It is not a license roster.
sources.request_process: No content-permission process is published. No one was contacted.

sources.scope: Live booking dropdown on 2026-11-25: 16 unique names, offshore 12, nearshore 3, inshore 1. Static prose on the site describes a different lineup. Defined sample: 3 of 16, with 2 supported and 1 held.
sources.access: Public website with an embedded booking widget. No terms, privacy, or copyright page was found.
sources.rights_basis: Silence. A current booking display is not a commercial-reuse grant.
sources.bulk: The dropdown is a 16-name current booking list.
sources.request_process: None published. No one was contacted.

sources.rights_basis: Statute text under nc.gov non-commercial copying terms. No roster and no commercial directory grant.

highest_priority_permission_question: Will the Division of Marine Fisheries release the current for-hire license file, including credential type, whether the holder is a person or a vessel, and the hull identifier, for commercial directory use, or is that file withheld under G.S. 113-170.3? The nc.gov terms grant only non-commercial copying of published pages. A marina booking page, a NOAA permit description, and a public-records lookup do not authorize a claimed listing.
recommended_first_source: Oregon Inlet Fishing Center live booking dropdown at https://www.oregon-inlet.com/our-fleet/, 47 names on 2026-11-25. It is a booking list, not a license roster. Next year's fleet is not final under the marina's terms, and commercial reuse is unknown until the marina grants it.
